name: Cliffspring Falls
summary: Cliffspring Falls pours from Darkshore’s eastern cliffs into the forest below. Its waters feed the Cliffspring River and once supplied nearby night elf settlements, but a foul taint now spreads through the river basin.

sections.title: A Tainted Source
sections.body: Cliffspring Falls pours from caves high in Darkshore’s eastern bluffs and feeds the Cliffspring River. The river winds west through the woods before emptying into the sea. Its clear waters once gave nearby night elf settlements their purest drinking water. Now they run murky and foul, spreading sickness and decay through the river basin. Naturalists investigating the falls have found the caves overrun by naga and cultists. They plot in the shadows, while demonic corruption from neighboring Felwood threatens to seep through the highland bedrock.

faq.answer: Cliffspring Falls pours from caves in eastern Darkshore and feeds the Cliffspring River. Its waters once supplied nearby settlements with their main source of fresh drinking water.

faq.q: Why is the water coming from the falls corrupted?
faq.answer: Demonic taint may be seeping through the mountains from Felwood, while Twilight’s Hammer cultists and naga occupy the caves feeding the falls.

faq.q: Who occupies the caverns behind the falls?
faq.answer: Naga and Twilight’s Hammer cultists occupy the flooded caves above and behind the waterfall.

faq.q: Why is Cliffspring Falls so important to Darkshore?
faq.answer: The Cliffspring River crosses northern Darkshore, and its waters are a principal source of fresh water. Their poisoning threatens wildlife, ancient groves, and night elf homes.

angles.text: As a night elf of Auberdine, you know the taint in Cliffspring Falls pollutes waters vital to Darkshore’s ancient forests. It threatens the forest’s health and spirit.
As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you watch the river closely and work to find and cleanse the unnatural rot threatening the wilderness.
